eps.o: It's Ice Week in Krapopolis! Tyrannis struggles to keep his cool when he gets the hots for a visiting reporter. Shlub is paid a visit by an old friend. Hippocampus and Stupendous risk missing the festivities altogether.
Tyrannis' little hunting mishap brings the Norse gods to Olympus. The family is forced to deal with the hunky Thor, the mischievous Loki, and some nasty bridge trolls.
Stupendous is at it again, making trips to the underworld to visit her old fling Prack. But this time, Hades is onto her. Tyrannis tries to teach Deliria and Shlub the value of human life.

Garbage is piling high in Krapopolis, but the townsfolk can't wrap their heads around the concept. Tyrannis discovers how to get them in the cleaning mood. Stupendous and Hippocampus become death, the destroyer of worlds.
Tyrannis is stuck in a time loop trying to save the city.
The family takes a vacation to Storgos for Shlub's mother's birthday.

eps.t: Ty Man Woman Table Chairs Food
eps.o: There's this new thing called a map, and all the cool cities are on it! Tyrannis and Hippocampus start a restaurant to earn Krapopolis its spot. Stupendous follows the map to face her long time foe.
Shlub is sick- well, one part of Shlub is sick. The family uses Hippocampus' new invention to extract and replace the ailing part, but might just need to operate on themselves in order to save him.
There's a new king in town - the Rug King. Horrible timing for a prophecy foretelling of Tyrannis' downfall. Stupendous tries to get deep with Deliria.
Deliria's clairvoyant ex comes to town and gives the family some bad news.
Tyrannis' favorite singer Stavros is in town! But he also happens to be the favorite singer of Athena and her radical followers. Deliria goes on a little getaway.
Aphrodite's Fertility Fest is here and baby fever is at an all time high; Tyrannis tries to relax at a bathhouse but it's proving difficult to let loose.
Ty plots to skip out on his wedding day since weddings are hotspots for familial bloodbaths; Stupendous bonds with her future uncle-in-law; Shlub puts on his dancing horseshoes.

Stupe and Ty are invited to a dating competition hosted by a mysterious princess in search of her partner and Hippo suspects it's a trap; Shlub and Deliria accidentally improve the city in Ty's absence.
Shlub has a little trick up his sleeve to help Ty stay cool in the heat; Deliria's temple becomes home to sweaty soldiers and worshipers seeking shelter from the heat - and love.
Ty tries not to judge a book by its cover when he and Stupe look to hire assistants; Hippo tries to have a romantic getaway with Daphne—and his parents.

eps.t: One Eye One Heart She's Stupe
eps.o: The legendary hero Hector and his grand fighting show come to town and Deliria signs Stupe up to fight... or rather, to perform. Ty discovers a new branch of his family tree.
Hippocampus has a pimple! He and Deliria travel to Dermiapolis for him to that ugly thing taken care of; Tyrannis gets sculpted.
Hippo accompanies Shlub on his journey to Minos, where treacherous labyrinths, minotaurs, and divorced dads await; Ty gets glued to his throne.
Love is in the air when Ty gets a second chance with Tina, Hippo and Stupe let romance come between them and Shlub finds a new passion: winning.
Ty gets a fancy new suit and with it, the confidence to invade Persia; Hippo is left home to defend the throne; Deliria and Shlub role-play.
Ty is tired of his family thinking he's not important enough to be assassinated. He'll show them!
